skills.skill_desc: Detona gains a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Big Guy</font> for 12s each time it or Barats damages an enemy with their skills (up to 10 stacks). Each stack of <font color="a6aafb">Big Guy</font> increases Detona's size and grants 4 - 10 <font color="26e407"><1999></font> (scales with the level of <font color="a6aafb">Detona's Welcome</font>). At max stacks, Detona gains 20% extra Resilience, and its Basic Attacks are replaced with <font color="a6aafb">Trample</font>, which deals <font color="fba51f"> (+140% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="26e407">(+3.5% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a circular area, slows them by 40% for 0.2s, and refreshes the duration of <font color="a6aafb">Big Guy</font> with each hit.

Detona spits contaminated oil in the target direction, dealing 60<font color="26e407"> (+7% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Barats then ignites the oil with a firecracker, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+180% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area (only 50% damage to Creeps).

The area of effect of <font color="a6aafb">So-Called Teamwork</font> increases with the number of <font color="a6aafb">Big Guy</font> stacks.

Barats fires two missiles at the target location, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing enemies by 40% for 1s. The missiles expel fumes from their exhausts upon landing, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a rectangular area and pushing them toward Barats.

After a short delay, Detona charges in the target direction, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="26e407">(+1.2% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit, devouring and suppressing them for 1.2s, then spitting them out. If the spat‑out target hits an enemy hero or a wall, it triggers an explosion. The target and nearby enemies take an additional 180<font color="fba51f"> (+105% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="26e407">(+5% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and are stunned for 1s.

During the skill, Barats becomes immune to control effects. If the cast is canceled or the skill misses, 50% of the skill cooldown is refunded.
If Detona successfully devours an enemy, he immediately gains max stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Big Guy</font>.
